title: Pocketwire Pay in 4 Purchase Disputes: Windows, Pauses and Outcomes
content:
A purchase split with Pocketwire Pay in 4 can be disputed within the tier's dispute window of calendar days after the purchase date, with no more than the tier's number of disputes open at the same time on the account.

### Dispute timeline by tier

| Tier | Dispute window after the purchase date (calendar days) | Disputes open at the same time, at most | Installments of the disputed plan paused for (calendar days) | Merchant's time to answer (calendar days) | Customer's time to upload evidence after opening (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter | 120 | 1 | 30 | 14 | 10 |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic | 120 | 1 | 30 | 14 | 10 |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Select | 120 | 2 | 30 | 14 | 10 |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Preferred | 120 | 2 | 45 | 14 | 10 |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Premier | 120 | 3 | 45 | 14 | 14 |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Elite | 120 | 3 | 60 | 14 | 14 |

The timeline applies according to the tier the account is on.

### Clauses

**1. Window.** A purchase can be disputed within 120 calendar days after its purchase date, counted in calendar days from that date.

**2. Open disputes.** A dispute is open from the day it is opened until it is decided. The disputes open on the account, the new one included, may not exceed the tier's number.

**3. Pause and deadlines.** While the dispute is open, the installments of the disputed plan pause for the tier's pause period of calendar days; the merchant has 14 calendar days to answer, and the customer has the tier's evidence period, counted in calendar days from the opening of the dispute, to upload evidence.

**4. Reasons.** A dispute is opened for one of four reasons: item not received, not as described, returned not refunded, or unauthorized. It is recorded against the plan with its reason and the date opened.

**5. Outcome.** A dispute is decided either for the customer or for the merchant.

| Outcome | Effect on the plan |
|---|---|
| Decided for the customer | The plan is reduced by the disputed amount, recorded as a merchant refund adjustment on the plan dated the day of the decision |
| Decided for the merchant | The schedule restarts, with the next installment due the day after the decision; the plan is reduced by nothing |

### Window boundary (hypothetical purchase dated day 0)

| Dispute opened on | Within the window? |
|---|---|
| Day 119 | Yes |
| Day 120 | Yes |
| Day 121 | No |

### Case (hypothetical account on Pocketwire Pay in 4 Select)

The account has one dispute open on another plan. A second dispute can be opened, bringing the open disputes to 2, the Select limit; while both stay open, a third cannot. The installments of the second plan pause for 30 calendar days. If that dispute is decided for the merchant on day 50 of a hypothetical calendar, the next installment of that plan falls due on day 51.
